source_clause: EDPR10.) The Edit Profile tab will have a maximum of 6 lines of information per page.
leaf_desc_037: EDPR10.) The Edit Profile tab will have a maximum of 6 lines of information per page.
reasoning: 驗證目標：9.9（EDPR10）—— Edit Profile 分頁每頁最多 6 行資訊。關鍵情境條件：須在選項最多之情況下才驗得到上限，故 pre-condition 要求各選用項目皆可用。為什麼這樣切：清單之順序屬 9.1，本 leaf 只管每頁行數之上限。

tcs.tc_title: Edit Profile tab shows at most six lines per page
tcs.test_item: Edit Profile tab shows at most six lines per page
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A Driver Profile is active with all optional items available
2. The vehicle is stationary
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the “Edit Profile” tab
2. Count the information lines shown and check that no more than six are on the page
tcs.expected_result:
1. The “Edit Profile” tab is displayed
2. At most six lines of information are shown on the page
tcs.priority_basis: 單頁最多 6 行 —— 版面上限，失效僅影響該頁可讀性
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
